decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several high-rated options including the premium Bang & Olufsen Beosound A1 and the highly popular JBL Clip 3. While the JBL Clip 3 has excellent reviews, I was looking for a mid-sized portable speaker with higher wattage and more robust bass output without jumping to the $250+ price range of the JBL Pulse 4 or the B&O. The mid-range options from EDUPLINK and comiso fit the power profile I want, but the review sections for these brands contain reports of reliability issues (dead on arrival) and sound distortion at higher volumes. Because none of the products perfectly balance sound quality, reliability, and price for a primary home/outdoor speaker, I have decided not to make a purchase during this session.
